verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical. In both, the 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' kicker is cut off from its headline and stranded in the top-left corner. The two owls have shrunk to tiny icons squeezed together in the middle, and the brown owl overlaps the blue one. The whole left half is just scattered confetti, so the layout is lopsided: a big empty area on the left and a crowded owl-and-headline block on the right. Neither keeps the original's framing, with an owl on each side of a centred title.
